result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，以零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过此前最优的微调方法 [abstract][S1.p11]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。此外，GPT-3 能生成人类评估者难以与人类撰写文章区分的新闻文章样本 [abstract][S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。作者认为这些结果表明超大规模语言模型可能是开发可适应、通用语言系统的重要组成部分 [S8.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调的范式虽然架构与任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模标注数据限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需简短指令或极少量示例即可完成新的语言任务 [S1.p5]。因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模能否大幅提升与任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
Here we show that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, which we call GPT-3, and measuring its in-context learning abilities.

method.text: 论文训练了 GPT-3，一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型，参数量是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但使用交替的稠密与局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。训练数据以过滤后的 Common Crawl 为主，并加入 WebText、两个书籍语料和英文维基百科 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。评估时对所有任务均不进行梯度更新或微调，任务与少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下评估 [S1.p9]。少样本设置中，K 通常取 10 到 100，受限于 2048 的上下文窗口 [S2.p2][S2.SS4.p2]。评估覆盖语言建模与完形填空、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 式任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE 和 NLI 等类别 [S3.p3]。此外还设计了算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成、使用新词和纠正语法等合成与定性任务 [S3.SS9.p1]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window
which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks
First, we test GPT-3’s ability to perform arithmetic.

findings.text: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过由微调模型保持的最优结果 [S1.p11]。例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本、单样本和少样本分别达到 81.5、84.0 和 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上分别达到 64.3%、68.0% 和 71.2% 准确率，其中少样本结果在相同闭卷设置下相对微调模型为最优 [S1.p11]。GPT-3 在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上也表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术和在只见过一次定义后使用新词 [S1.p12]。同时，论文发现部分任务即使对 GPT-3 而言少样本表现仍然不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。在新闻生成上，人类评估者识别 1750 亿参数模型生成文章的准确率仅约 52%，接近随机水平 [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

evidence.quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如样本在文档层面语义重复、长段落失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。在“常识物理”问题上 GPT-3 似乎特别困难，并且在比较类任务（如 WiC 和 ANLI）以及部分阅读理解任务上，单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。作者还指出模型存在结构性局限：实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、回看比较两段内容或需要重读长文后生成极短答案的任务表现 [S5.p3]。此外，作者承认预训练样本效率仍然较差，GPT-3 在预训练中看到的文本远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]；少样本学习究竟是从头学习新任务还是识别训练中见过的任务仍不明确 [S5.p6]；并且如此规模的模型推理昂贵且不便，可能影响实际应用 [S5.p7]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
GPT-3 seems to have special difficulty with “common sense physics”
it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on
